title: THE ALERT IS POLISHED
why: His answer of 2026-10-14 on the alert lane: polish the UI as you see fit, consistent with AAA practices. The headline of an alert is now the large size of the HUD (it was the size of a prompt), the plate drops in from a little above as it fades in, and a thin time bar along its foot runs down with the life of the alert, so a callout shows how long it will stay. The detail line under the headline keeps its size.
now: The alert headline is larger, the plate drops in, and a time bar runs down along its foot.
